'''Gallitrea''' is a [[high elf]] jewelcrafting vendor located in [[Moro'gai Village]] in [[Moonwhisper Coast]].

==Quotes==
;Gossip
Greetings <Class>. I am sure you are surprised to see me amongst these Draenei, am I not sticking out like a sore thumb. I have ventured the world for many years, learned many of its secrets and ultimately settled down on this bewitched coast. My trade is the jewelcrafting, and I have learned under the best tutor there is. If you are interested in some supplies, I am more than eager to strike a deal with you.
